top_choice_rationale: P001 is a nameable phenomenon in nature, the time-reversal-invariant Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall effect, predicted by Kane and Mele and then observed as quantised edge conductance in HgTe quantum wells by Molenkamp, with about two decades of independent confirmation. The narrowed citation avoids claiming the three-dimensional work. The attribution gap (Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang; Fu, Moore, Balents, Hasan) is real but can be stated openly. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is next: mature, reproduced and cleanly allocated to two names, though it overlaps with earlier metrology prizes. P003 (fluctuation theorems) is sound physics but has one supporter and an unavoidable credit gap (Crooks, Searles). I still prefer it to no award.
